prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1013; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of side impact collision at intersection. Insured vehicle was struck on driver side by second vehicle that entered intersection against signal. Claimant reports neck strain and stiffness, no loss of consciousness. Police report requested. Claimant is not represented by counsel at this time.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant describes onset of neck pain within hours of collision, rated moderate, worse on turning head. Claimant has not yet seen a physician. Advised claimant of medical evaluation options and to keep records of all treatment and out-of-pocket costs. Claimant confirmed no legal representation.

Entry 3: Reviewed photos submitted by claimant showing driver door damage and deployed side curtain airbag. Scene diagram from responding officer indicates other driver cited for failure to obey traffic control device. Liability appears clear in favor of claimant. Recorded statement scheduled.

Entry 4: Recorded statement taken from claimant. Claimant states they were stopped briefly before proceeding on green light and were struck before they could react. Claimant reports ongoing neck discomfort, headaches on some days, and missed two shifts of work. Claimant asked how the claim process works; provided general explanation and referred to claim brochure. No representation noted.

Entry 5: Received medical report from urgent care confirming diagnosis of cervical strain with recommendation for physical therapy and follow-up in two weeks. Medical file noted and reserve reviewed. Claimant advised of right to pursue direct payment for treatment under the at-fault party's liability coverage. Will follow up on wage documentation and therapy authorization.
